advance_rule: Screen mean must exceed the matched first 32 single-view neural-control pairings; only then run the independently seeded 128-pair confirmation.
allocation: Temporarily resume main PPO with two workers; one rollout worker; restore three main workers after completed trials or failure.
confirmation_rule: Retain for full final evaluation only if the independent mixed-field pairing bootstrap 95% lower bound is above 50%; final primary/standard gates still required.
scope: One fixed independent-rollout follow-up; validation only; final test data unopened
